Package com.gothru.panorra
Scope Panorra Mobile - Profile Settings Sheet, Legal Policy Routing, Privacy Policy In-App Viewer & Web Document Integration
Verdict 🐞 BUG / FAILED (Text Not Readable / Contrast Defect)

🧪 Test Scenarios & Acceptance Verification

No Scenario Execution Type Expected Result Actual Result Status
1 Navigate to Profile Settings & locate Privacy Policy item Black-Box Privacy Policy menu entry is visible with shield icon and accessible Menu item visible and clickable ✅ PASS
2 Open Privacy Policy in In-App Browser Black-Box / Gray-Box In-app browser launches with canonical URL (https://panorra.com/privacy-policy.html) In-app browser opened successfully ✅ PASS

🔬 Multi-Method Testing Coverage

Method Scope & Coverage Findings / Observations
Black-Box Testing Verified Settings sheet navigation, menu item interaction, web view launch, scrolling, and readability. 🐞 Defect Found: The page text/description is invisible or barely readable due to contrast/styling mismatch on dark theme.
Gray-Box Testing Inspected SETTINGS_LINKS.privacyPolicy link resolution and In-App Browser launch triggers. URL resolves to privacy policy page, but styling injection/theme fails to adapt font color for readability.
White-Box Testing Inspected ProfileSettingsSheet.tsx and LegalHtml.tsx styling properties. Font color / background container styling requires contrast adjustment for readable rendering.

📊 Confusion Matrix

Category Predicted Positive (Pass) Predicted Negative (Fail)
Actual Positive 3 (True Positive - Navigation, Launch, Dismissal) 0 (False Negative)
Actual Negative 0 (False Positive) 1 (True Negative - Unreadable text contrast defect)

Accuracy: 75% (3/4 Passed, 1 Critical Visual Bug)

🐞 Bug Description & Impact

  • Defect: Description and content text in the Privacy Policy page are not readable / not visible to users due to dark text rendering on a dark background.
  • Impact: Users cannot read the legal Privacy Policy document within the application.

🎥 Evidence & Artifacts

  • Video Walkthrough (Real Device):
smoke_test_1360.mp4
  • Screenshot Defect End-State:

Panorra Mobile - Privacy Policy Text Unreadable Contrast Defect

📝 Conclusion & Developer Recommendations

  • Status: 🐞 BUG REPORTED
  • Action Required: Update text styling or HTML container background/foreground properties in Privacy Policy viewer / web document so that the policy description and headings remain readable across all themes.

[Help] Terms of Service Report and Documentation

Tested by :

QA (Quality Assurance) @ekosy9

Project :

Panorra Mobile @lundara02

Environment & Test Data :

Item Details
Device Model Samsung Galaxy A23 (SM-A235F)
OS Version Android 14 (One UI 6.1)
App Version Panorra Mobile v1.9.46
Theme Mode Dark Theme / System Dark
Active Environment Dev / Production API
Test Account @ekosymm (Eko Syaepulloh Qa)
Endpoint Tested https://panorra.com/legal/terms-of-service.html

Description of Feature :

The Terms of Service feature allows users to access, read, and review GoThru Media / Panorra legal conditions, user policies, copyright notices, and platform rules directly within the app via a responsive HTML view.

Bug Summary :

  • Issue: Terms of Service text appears black / dark against dark theme background, making the legal text unreadable on Dark Mode.
  • Root Cause: src/shared/components/LegalHtml.tsx does not pass baseStyle={{ color: textColor }} to <RenderHtml />, causing unstyled HTML elements (<body>, <div>, <i>, etc.) to default to black text (#000000) on a dark background.

Main Functions & Scenario :

Title Scenario
Description : Verification of Terms of Service access from Profile Settings, HTML legal document text visibility across themes, vertical scrolling, and back navigation.
Actor : User / Authenticated User
Interface : Profile > Settings Bottom Sheet > Terms of Service Screen
Pre-Condition : Panorra app is running with Dark Theme enabled.
Basic Flow : Actor System
1. Tap Profile tab from bottom navigation. Navigates to Profile screen.
2. Tap Settings (gear icon) in header. Opens Settings bottom sheet menu.
3. Scroll down and tap "Terms of Service". Fetches HTML from legal API and renders Terms of Service screen.
4. Review document readability. Text renders in black/dark styling, causing poor contrast and unreadable text in Dark Theme.
Correct scenario and corresponding result : Terms of Service HTML text should dynamically adapt to the active theme color (`text-basic-color` / `text-foreground`), ensuring high contrast and clear readability on both Light and Dark modes.
Correct scenario and incorrect result : BUG FOUND: Text color remains black on dark background in Dark Mode.
Incorrect scenario and corresponding result : None
Incorrect scenario and non-conforming result : None
Feature Finish Date : 21 September 2026
Previous Flow : - First-time onboarding terms agreement flow (`isFirst` prop support)

Testing Methods Coverage :

Method Scope & Execution Status
Black-box Testing Verified UI layout and contrast on dark theme. Text readability failed due to black font on dark background. FAILED (BUG)
Gray-box Testing Verified API endpoint https://panorra.com/legal/terms-of-service.html fetch response and state transition. PASS
White-box Testing Inspected src/shared/components/LegalHtml.tsx. Identified missing baseStyle={{ color: textColor }} in <RenderHtml />. IDENTIFIED

Confusion Matrix :

Predicted Positive (Functional) Predicted Negative (Defective)
Actual Positive (Working) TP: 0 FN: 0
Actual Negative (Failing) FP: 0 TN: 1 (Dark mode text contrast defect detected)

Evidence :

1. End-State Screenshot (Contrast Defect)

2. Real-Device Execution Video

smoke_test_1047.mp4

Smoke Testing Summary History :

No. Period Version Feature Evidence Status Description
1. 20 December 2023 1.0.99.34 Terms of Service None Pass Running well
2. 21 September 2026 1.9.46 Terms of Service Video & Screenshot Bug Dark mode text color contrast bug on Samsung Galaxy A23 (Android 14)

Conclusion : 🐞

Bug: On Dark Mode, Terms of Service content displays black text on dark background, causing text to be unreadable. Requires updating LegalHtml.tsx to apply baseStyle={{ color: textColor }} and tag styles for div, body, i, span, and other text elements.

"Street View Post" refers to the process of uploading and publishing 360-degree images or virtual tours to Google Street View. This feature allows users, such as photographers or businesses, to share immersive, panoramic images of streets, landmarks, and interior spaces with the public. Once posted, these images can be explored on Google Maps and Google Earth, providing a virtual experience of the location. It's commonly used to enhance online visibility for businesses or to share scenic views and travel experiences.
